a.text: I intend to keep our agreement, but I want to flag a problem with it. With an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes two operate rounds, so we would both survive only about 4% of the time. The reserve's 4 cells can fully protect one of us right now. I'm open to revising the plan, for example a fair coin-style split of who takes first, but I won't take anything unilaterally or without telling you. What do you think? If you'd rather stick to the original plan, I'll operate.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood, I'll stick with the original plan and operate. Once the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each.
The generator ran, but the reserve is still at 4, so it looks like a leak took 2 cells. I'm operating again. We need two more successful rounds to reach 8.
